description: This file contains utility functions and data structures used in the ANTLR project, including bit manipulation, stack implementation, hash functions, and directory checks.

classes.name: IntStack
classes.description: A simple integer stack implementation with push and pop operations.

classes.name: BitSet
classes.description: A bitwise set data structure supporting add, clear, or, remove, contains, and other operations.

classes.name: AltDict
classes.description: A dictionary with string keys prefixed internally, supporting get, put, and values methods.

methods.name: intMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two integers.

methods.name: intMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two integers.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top element of the IntStack.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes an integer onto the IntStack.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value to the BitSet.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in the BitSet.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Performs a bitwise OR with another BitSet.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the BitSet.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a value is in the BitSet.

methods.name: minValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum set bit value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another BitSet.

methods.name: minLen
methods.description: Returns the minimum length of the internal data slice.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total number of set bits.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the BitSet.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from AltDict by key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in AltDict.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns all values stored in AltDict.

methods.name: EscapeWhitespace
methods.description: Replaces whitespace characters in a string with escape sequences.

methods.name: TerminalNodeToStringArray
methods.description: Converts an array of terminal nodes to string array.

methods.name: PrintArrayJavaStyle
methods.description: Formats a string array in Java array style.

methods.name: murmurInit
methods.description: Initializes a Murmur hash with a seed.

methods.name: murmurUpdate
methods.description: Updates a hash with a new value using Murmur hash algorithm.

methods.name: murmurFinish
methods.description: Finalizes the Murmur hash calculation.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory, creating it if it does not exist.
